label: Bible Study
prompt: In whose _____ is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verse: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
note: Job's answer to his friends — even the beasts know whose hand holds every living breath.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my _____ remaineth among you: fear ye not.
verse: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
note: To the weary rebuilders: the covenant from the Exodus still stands, and my spirit remaineth among you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David sat between the two gates: and the _____ went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verse: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
note: David waited between the gates for news of the battle while the watchman scanned the road from the roof.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open _____, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verse: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
note: To Philadelphia, with only 'a little strength': an open door no one can shut — faithfulness outranks size.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The fire shall ever be _____ upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verse: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
note: The altar fire was never to go out — it 'shall ever be burning' — a favorite picture of devotion that never cools.
